gate_transpose_derived_lines.claim: the columns' operator transposes through its walled solves: the walled read's identity <c', A^-1 r> = <A^-T c', r> on that solve's own inputs' scale within the CG's stop, and the whole product's on its own within the walled read's share of that line and the dense parts' rounding

prediction.unit: the walled read's miss on |y||r| + |c'||x|; the whole product's on |c||J b| + |J^T c||b|
prediction.basis: derived: the miss is <y, rho_1> - <rho_2, x>, at most tau each way on the solve's inputs' scale; tau at most the inner tolerance (1e-2 of the columns') raised to the floor under 100 tolerances plus the floor again (2e-4 float32, 1e-10 float64), sqrt(2) for the half-weighted norm, so 5.66e-4 and 2.8e-10; the whole line adds 2 n eps (n = 3N = 150) and carries the walled line at its measured share of the scale
prediction.why: the near field's dense product and the box's spectral solve are exact transposes up to rounding (measured: their misses equal clean and planted); only the CG stops short

gate_transpose_derived_lines.metric: both identities' misses, evaluated in float64 from the run's vectors

control.plant: plain: the shared CG's solves declared symmetric, the open grid's weighted transpose dropped
control.expected_rate: float64: 20/20 by both identities. float32: NOT every run: the derived line cannot separate the plant (its least miss seen 1.08 times the walled line; the whole line above most planted draws), so float32 is reported as not discriminating this plant, and the control is float64's
control.resolution: float64: the plant 6.1e-4 at least on the walled read against a line of 2.8e-10, and 2e-6 on the whole against 1e-12. float32: the walled line 5.66e-4 (the CG stop's guaranteed bound, not the 8e-7 these solves reach) against the plant's 6.1e-4 to 2.9e-2

gate_transpose_derived_lines.if_wrong: a clean walled miss over the line would be a transpose solve that is not the forward solve's transpose (or a stop looser than the rule); a planted draw under it, the plant's share at the opening planes smaller than seen
gate_transpose_derived_lines.cannot_discriminate_if: float32: it does not (above); float64: a plant draw under 2.8e-10 on the walled read
